title: First overview document: Understand Yoke
name: First overview document: Understand Yoke
audience: Humans learning the product and agents needing a compact product model
scope: Global/static; applies across local, self-hosted and hosted modes
trigger: First intentional read after the docs landing, help link or setup handoff
current: The existing index.md and start/concepts.md split introductory material and contain some duplicated or stale workflow/navigation descriptions.
proposed_purpose: Give the minimum model needed to make a good first request.
content: Humans choose outcomes and make required decisions; agents and deterministic workers execute and retain evidence.
A universe holds shared state; projects own their work; a machine runs sessions against that state.
A current plan states near-term intent; items make work concrete; workflows determine how that work proceeds.
Use an agent for planning/execution, the workbench for progress/decisions, and CLI help for exact commands.
Direct work, document-led work and decomposed work are choices based on the task; the agent can recommend the workflow.
Steering staffs work from a strategy document; selecting one ready item is a separate action.
Verification proves an outcome; QA review and deployment approval are different decisions; merge-only work need not deploy.
A new project and a mature project both fit: adopt existing direction, tests and delivery before adding new machinery.
Local reachability, optional GitHub integration and projectless coordination are boundaries worth knowing; deeper details remain linked.
authority_and_reuse: Consolidate introductory prose into one canonical overview, reusing start/concepts.md if practical. Keep deep definitions in their canonical chapters and link them. Do not include the exhaustive TOC, command table or Yoke-maintainer production policy.
distinct_from: This is authored explanation with one compact work-cycle picture if helpful, not a navigation catalog or setup wizard.
proposal_status: Proposed consolidation and correction of existing introductory docs
